# Euphoria Wellness Studio

> Euphoria is a wellness and fitness studio in Blagoevgrad, Bulgaria, offering Pilates Reformer and XBODY EMS training.

The studio provides personalized training in a supportive environment at 3 Ilinden Street, 2700 Blagoevgrad, Bulgaria.

## Main website

- [Euphoria Wellness Studio](https://euphoria-wellness.com/): Official information about the studio, services, gallery, working hours, location, and contact options.

## Services

- [Pilates Reformer and XBODY EMS](https://euphoria-wellness.com/#services): Information about the training services offered by the studio.

## Contact

- [Contact Euphoria](https://euphoria-wellness.com/#contact): Studio address, working hours, telephone numbers, email, contact form, and map.
